Try this: Keep the stone wall as the backdrop.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with soft, shoulder-length
light brown waves sits on a stone ledge in front of a
weathered stone wall. She wears a fitted black
short-sleeve knit dress with a cream collar, cream
placket, and pearl buttons, with cream trim at the
cuffs and hem. A simple gold bracelet sits on one
wrist. Her expression is calm and composed,
looking toward the camera. Soft natural daylight, a
palette of black, cream, and warm stone. Refined
and classic, in the style of a timeless street portrait.
